The step wasn't costing completions — everyone who reached it finished. It was a mostly-skipped extra screen: 77% tapped "Skip · I'll do it later". Your field read and the data agree, so it's gone. (Second time, too: the same step was cut 2026-05-27 on tester feedback and reintroduced 2026-07-09 as a measurable bet. The bet settled; PLAN §9 now says don't re-add it without new evidence.)

The flow now — 3 steps, claim finishes

The yellow bar in the handle field is ImageRenderer's placeholder for a live TextField — a snapshot-harness artifact, not the real UI. On device it's the normal @-prefixed input.

Behavior changes

  • FLOW "Claim handle" is now the finish line: a successful claim (or the offline fallback) fires onboarding_completed and drops you straight into AR. A 409/422 still keeps you on the step with the inline error.
  • LABELS Steps renumbered "STEP n / 3"; the handle step reads "FINAL STEP · PUBLIC HANDLE"; progress bar is 3 segments. The quiet-skip footer state died with the step.
  • CALIBRATION Coaching lives where it already worked: the loud in-AR COMPASS OFF ±N° banner → CompassCalibrationSheet (figure-8 + live readout). That surface and its compass-triad telemetry are untouched; Figure8Animation moved into that file.
  • TELEMETRY onboarding_completed no longer carries calibrated; step index 3 would report step_3 (never fires). Old events keep their properties — dashboards filtering on calibrated just stop getting new rows.

Verification

  • Full TailspotTests suite green in the iPhone 17 simulator (exit 0).
  • Step-name + completed-properties tests updated to pin the new vocabulary.
  • Snapshot harness renders steps 0–2 (SE-height render moved to the handle step).
